_source: Sarah's rulings: MASTER_DECISIONS_REGISTER, 28 Sep 2026 reconciled spec, 3 Oct 2026 rulings, V1_RELEASE_PLAN.md, docs/V1_ACCESS_MODEL_IMPLEMENTATION.md R01-R08, frontend/CLAUDE.md, POINTS_BADGE_LOGIC v1.1, QUICK_REPORT_TAXONOMY_BACKEND_SPEC. Where backend code disagrees, the ruling wins and the code is a fix item.

notes: No annual plan. Prices come from the store, never hardcoded in the real app.
A Family/Group plan covers ONE nominated group. Members join free. It gives nobody personal benefits, including the payer.
Creating and joining a group is free. Check in, Check on, SOS and Journey in an uncovered group need each participant's own ALRT +.
Individually funded groups are capped at 20 people (3 Oct 2026).
Tier names follow git: ALRT +, ALRT + Family (6), ALRT + Group 20, ALRT + Group 50.

paywallMoments: first Check in, Check on, SOS or Journey in an uncovered group
Create a group then choose to cover it

responseRouting.onMyWay: other recipients only, never the sender

wording.sosDisclaimer: SOS notifies the people you chose. ALRT never contacts emergency services. In danger? Call your local emergency number.
wording.communityDisclaimer: Community reports are not verified by authorities and can be wrong. Always follow official advice.
wording.notAnEmergencyService: ALRT is not an emergency service. Alerts can be late or wrong. In a life-threatening situation, call your local emergency number first. Do not wait.
wording.locationPromise: Your location leaves your phone only when you send it. No tracking in the background. A sent location expires after an hour.
wording.noDashes: no em dashes or en dashes in any user-facing copy
wording.ageGate: I am 16 or older, or local law allows me to use this app

Emergency Warnings always pop; other levels follow the notification level. Trips run through the backend (/maps/trips) so the server decides what is ahead
